designationHistory.indexText: Established Feb. 4, 1964, in Montana's Bitterroot Valley; renamed in 1978 for Sen. Lee Metcalf.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Lee Metcalf National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

review.note: Parser grabbed a sentence about the National Trails System Act (1968). Refuge established Feb. 4, 1964 (CCP). The earlier name (often given as Ravalli NWR) was not confirmed here, so name is left unset.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: National Recreation Trails were established by the National Trails System Act of 1968 (Public Law 90-543), which authorized creation of a national trails system composed of National Recreation Trails, National Scenic Trails and National Historic Trails.
